description.value:
Fun fact: the Igla was conceived at the beginning of the 21st century as a hunting weapon. Specifically, it was engineered to hunt ducks (medium-sized waterfowl, somewhat similar to seagulls, now considered extinct). The Igla may have fared well against the ducks of Serbia's swamplands, but in 2077's Night City, this shotgun is considered an antique that not even the city's poor and desperate are willing to resort to. Many complain that it produces more noise than damage.

Cost: 150eb (Premium)

Class: PQ Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Long Barrel Shotgun

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 2 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Each of this weapon’s two barrels can load a different ammunition type (Can be Slug or Shell), with the user choosing which to use when firing this weapon.

Range: Long Barrel Shotgun
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
